text:
alex.p: Hey team — first-day blocker. Windows VPN connects fine, but from WSL (Ubuntu) I can't reach our internal git server (git.internal.redwood.dev). Windows `git clone` works, WSL times out. Using Okta + AnyConnect (split-tunnel). Anyone seen this?
samira: hey @alex.p — yep this is common with WSL2. Quick q: which distro/version and are you on WSL1 or WSL2? Also paste `ip route` and `cat /etc/resolv.conf` from WSL if you can.
alex.p: WSL2, Ubuntu 22.04. `ip route` shows default via 172.20.48.1 dev eth0, no route for 10.40.0.0/16. `cat /etc/resolv.conf` shows nameserver 172.20.48.1. Windows `route print` shows routes for 10.40.0.0 via the VPN adapter. So looks like windows has the route but WSL doesn't.
yuki: yep — WSL2 uses a virtualized NIC and doesn't automatically inherit Windows route table for all adapters, especially with split-tunnel VPNs. Two quick options: (1) add the route inside WSL, or (2) use SSH through the bastion (ProxyJump). Which do you prefer?
alex.p: I'd prefer the route add so my dev workflow in WSL works (install, test, etc). How do I do that safely?
samira: try this (run in PowerShell as admin to get the VPN gateway IP if needed):
```
# from WSL: add route to private network via Windows host
sudo ip route add 10.40.0.0/16 via 172.20.48.1 dev eth0
# then test: ping 10.40.12.5
```
If it works, you can make it persistent on WSL startup by adding a small script to `~/.profile` or use a systemd user unit. Note: you may need to `wsl --shutdown` from Windows and restart WSL after the VPN connects so the interface is fresh.
alex.p: ran the `ip route add` and `ping` now responds, git clone starts. 🎉 Thanks. I had to `wsl --shutdown` first like you said.
yuki: nice. FYI alternatives: if you don't want to add routes, you can set an SSH `ProxyJump` through `redwood-bastion` so git traffic tunnels over the bastion:
```
# ~/.ssh/config
Host *.internal.redwood.dev
  ProxyJump bastion
```
That avoids changing WSL networking.
infra-bot: Docs: https://wiki.redwood.internal/vpn/wsl-troubleshoot — includes route snippet and a note to escalate to infra if you want automatic route propagation.
alex.p: I'll keep the manual route for now and open a ticket if this becomes frequent. Thanks @samira @yuki! I'll drop a note in #new-hires about the WSL caveat. :thumbsup:
